postings.description:
A Study on Automation of Verification Reports for Cyber Security

Karlskoga,

Sweden

Closing date: 30 October 2026

Apply for this job!

Är du en student som är ivrig att tillämpa dina teoretiska kunskaper och nya perspektiv på verkliga utmaningar? På Saab tror vi att innovationer växer på nya idéer, och ditt examensarbete kan vara gnistan som tänder vårt nästa tekniska genombrott.

Din roll

Vi ser det enorma värdet som studenter tillför vårt företag. Din akademiska precision, i kombination med din entusiasm för avancerad teknik, gör att du kan närma dig problem med en unik och insiktsfull lins. På Saab får du möjlighet att samarbeta med erfarna ingenjörer och specialister, få ovärderlig praktisk erfarenhet och samtidigt bidra till vår tillväxt och utveckling.

Bakgrund

Cybersäkerhetsteamet vid BUMS ansvarar för att säkerställa att våra produkter uppfyller våra kunders höga krav på informationssäkerhet. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt och genom hela produktens livscykel – från kravhantering och design till leverans och förvaltning. Teamet består av medarbetare med varierande erfarenheter, vilket innebär möjligheten att samarbeta med både juniora och seniora kollegor. Vi arbetar med såväl äldre som ny teknik, då vi har en bred produktportfölj som omfattar understödjande vapen- och missilsystem, drönare, pansarvärn, kamouflage, militära träningssystem samt militära fältsjukhus med mera. Vi följer utvecklingen inom cybersäkerhet nationellt och internationellt, där vi ser till att bevaka regulatoriska krav och branschstandarder samt utvärderar kontinuerligt nya tekniker och metoder för att stärka produkternas säkerhet.

Beskrivning av examensarbetet

Examensarbetet fokuserar på att automatisera processen för generering av verifieringsrapporter. Med särskild tonvikt på hur man kan mata in en konfigurationsdokumentation i ett verktyg som analyserar och jämför branschledande standarder och genererar förbättringsförslag. Arbetet syftar till att utveckla en lösning där systemet inte bara identifierar avvikelser från rekommendationer, utan även anpassar förbättringsförslagen utifrån specifika kundkrav och godkända avsteg som gjorts i konfigurationen.

Din profil

Arbetet är lämpligt för 1–2 studenter med intresse för informationssäkerhet, cybersäkerhet eller applikationssäkerhet. Dessutom vill vi att du har ett intresse för systemutvecklingsmetodik med en extra fallenhet för automatisering av processer med hjälp exempelvis AI.

Du/ni är i slutet av din/er utbildning inom datateknik eller informatik men andra relaterade områden kan vara av intresse, och ska påbörja ett examensarbete om 15HP.

Vi ger dig det stöd och den vägledning du behöver för att omsätta dina teoretiska kunskaper i praktiska lösningar. Bli en drivande kraft bakom Saabs tekniska framsteg!

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har gått ut.

Vad du blir en del av

Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.

Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med syfte att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidra till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.

Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.

Regardless of whether you value cutting edge technology, creativity or an innovative environment, everyone at Saab contributes to keeping people and society safe.

postings.description:
Associate Systems Engineer

Adelaide,

Australia

Closing date: 25 October 2026

Apply for this job!

Multiple Opportunities – Mawson Lakes Adelaide

Join Saab Australia (Saab) and help shape the future of defence, security and cyber technology.

For more than 35 years, Saab Australia has been a leading provider of defence, civil and security solutions, with an enduring purpose to keep people and society safe. We combine global expertise with local knowledge to deliver innovative, world-class solutions that support critical operations across Australia’s defence and security industries. From cyber security and communications to advanced defence systems and mixed reality technologies, our teams work on meaningful projects that make a real impact.

If you're looking for challenging work, cutting-edge technology, and the opportunity to contribute to something bigger, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer

At Saab Australia, we recognise that meaningful work is just one part of a rewarding career. We support our people with benefits that enhance wellbeing, flexibility and financial security, including:

- Up to 6 weeks leave
- 14% employer superannuation contribution
- Free Income Protection Insurance

For further information about a career at Saab, visit the page adjacent: https://www.saab.com/markets/australia/careers/saab-life

The role

Expression of Interest: Associate Systems Engineer
Saab Australia is seeking aspiring Systems Engineer to join our growing teams in Mawson Lakes, South Australia. This role offers the opportunity to develop your systems engineering skills while supporting the delivery and sustainment of leading-edge defence capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

- Assist in gathering and analysing system requirements from stakeholders.
- Support the development of requirements documentation and traceability matrices.
- Contribute to the creation of system architecture and design specifications.
- Participate in design reviews and provide feedback to ensure system requirements are met.
- Aid in the integration of hardware and software components into the system.
- Work alongside experienced engineers to implement system solutions and configurations.
- Participate in testing activities, including functional, integration, and system testing.

About you

Your skills and experience will include:

- Up to 2 years’ experience in Systems Engineering activities prior to this role.
- Fundamental understanding of systems engineering principles and practices.
- Basic familiarity with military systems or related defence technologies is desirable.
- Familiarity of System Engineering in an ASDEFCON context is desirable.

All Applicants must be Australian citizens and hold or be able to obtain an Australian Defence Security Clearance to baseline/NV1/NV2 level. Information including past and present nationality and citizenship may be requested to check eligibility for access to materials controlled under various export control regimes, including ITAR.

Flexible work arrangements such as hybrid work from home / office and a 9-day fortnight will be considered for this role.

What you will be part of

- Explore a world of possibilities. Tackle challenges, drive innovation, and grow your career in an environment where curiosity and diverse perspectives are valued. Together, we achieve extraordinary outcomes, and your contribution matters.
- Saab is a leading defence and security company with an enduring purpose to help nations keep their people and society safe. Supported by 28,000 employees worldwide, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
- The company develops, manufactures, and sustains advanced systems across aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors, and underwater systems. Headquartered in Sweden, Saab has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defence capability of several nations. Learn more about Saab here.
- We're committed to creating an environment where our people feel supported, empowered and inspired to do their best work.

Job Description:

Saab, Inc. is seeking an Associate Systems Engineer who’s motivated to learn about and work on complex electronic surveillance systems for commercial and government customers. This role is critical to successfully developing products and executing projects to achieve Saab’s vision – It’s a human right to feel safe.

This position is located at our East Syracuse, NY, office.

Responsibilities include:

- Using technical documentation, hands-on time, and guidance from senior engineers to learn sensor data processing, analog and digital hardware, computer networking, and embedded & server software systems.

- Performing hands-on technical investigations into air traffic control and sensor processing hardware and software.

- Supporting new feature development and change requests from internal product maintenance and international customers.

- Creating and maintaining product specifications and technical documentation to support customer deliverables and internal systems engineering processes.

- Supporting field teams during deployment of customer systems.

Compensation:

- $72,000 - $90,000

The compensation range provided is a general guideline. When extending an offer, Saab, Inc. considers factors including (but not limited to) the role and associated responsibilities, location, and market and business considerations, as well as the candidate's work experience, key skills, and education/training.

Skills and Experience:

Required:

- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or equivalent

- 0-3 years of relevant experience in safety critical or mission critical industries (e.g., aerospace, defense/military, medical, transportation, nuclear, etc.)

- Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to form productive relationships in a team environment

- Excellent written and oral communications skills

- International projects often require working evening hours to support customer meetings.

- Domestic and international travel may be required, typically less than 5%.

- Advanced degree in Engineering, Physics, Mathematics, or related discipline

Citizenship Requirements:

Must be a U.S. citizen, Permanent Resident (green card holder), or protected individual as defined by 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Headquartered in Syracuse, New York, the company has business units and local employees in ten U.S. locations.

postings.description:
Business Information Security Officer

Solna or Göteborg,

Sweden

Closing date: 15 October 2026

Apply for this job!

Want to influence the bigger picture? At Saab, you can realise amazing innovations that keep people and societies safe. Together, we can truly make an impact – and your part matters.

Your role

We are looking for a structured and relationship-driven Business Information Security Officer to join Business Area Surveillance. As a Business Information Security Officer, you will act as the information security partner within the business, driving the practical implementation of the Security Management System (SMS).

You will work closely with business units and security colleagues to ensure that security requirements are integrated into daily operations in a way that supports both compliance and business objectives. A key part of the role is enabling secure ways of working and helping the organization manage information efficiently and responsibly.

Your main tasks will be:

- Integrate the Security Management System (SMS) into business operations and align security with business needs.
- Develop practical solutions for secure information handling and communication.
- Support business units in implementing information security requirements effectively.
- Promote a strong security culture through awareness, engagement, and education.
- Represent business needs within the Information and Cyber Security organization.
- Act as the main point of contact for information security guidance and support.
- Coordinate local information security incident investigations and remediation activities.
- Translate security risks and requirements into clear business-focused recommendations.

Preferred locations for this role are Solna/Stockholm or Kallebäck/Göteborg.

Your profile

Personal qualities are of paramount importance for this role. We are looking for someone with unwavering integrity, strong ethics, and a high level of trustworthiness. You should possess the ability to build and cultivate strong professional networks and relationships, both internally and externally. You are a self-starter who can work independently while remaining a collaborative team player, always maintaining a focus on the business and the collective result. Finally, you must have a mature understanding of "balanced security" – the ability to implement robust security measures that enable, rather than hinder, a business-driven environment.

Required skills:

- University degree and/or relevant experience in information security, IT security, risk management, or a related field.
- Strong knowledge of information security principles and frameworks such as ISO/IEC 27001, NIST 800-171, protective security and COMSEC.
- Knowledge of relevant laws, regulations, and industry standards.
- Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and collaboration skills.
- Ability to balance security requirements with operational efficiency and business objectives.
- Experience working in multidisciplinary teams and coordinating with multiple stakeholders.
- Professional proficiency in Swedish and English.

Desired skills:

- Broad understanding of security disciplines and their interaction within a larger security framework.
- Experience from the defense industry, government authorities, or global organizations.
- Experience supporting organizational change and building a positive security culture.
- Ability to communicate technical security requirements to both technical and non-technical audiences.

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be a part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.

Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. We have a strong and growing product development organization made up of experienced professionals and talented junior engineers. Our product roadmap is healthy well into the future, offering a variety of technically meaningful challenges.

To support our long-term roadmap and ambitious technology goals, we are looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer to help develop and maintain the infrastructure, tools, and processes that enable efficient, secure, and high-quality software and product delivery.

We are seeking a hands-on professional with strong experience in DevOps toolchains, automation, CI/CD, and Kubernetes-based platforms.

Your role

As a DevOps Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, implementing, securing, and maintaining the development infrastructure used throughout the product lifecycle, including the underlying network connectivity and security controls. The environment includes source code and artifact management, build and release automation, test infrastructure, Kubernetes-based platforms, and integrations supporting requirements management, verification, validation, and product releases.

You will collaborate closely with development teams to streamline development workflows and introduce modern tools and practices that support developers in their daily work.

Main Responsibilities

- Maintain and continuously improve the development environment and DevOps toolchain, manage source code repositories, build systems, CI/CD pipelines, and artifact repositories.
- Design, implement, and maintain secure, resilient network connectivity for development, build, test and deployment environments and troubleshoot issues.
- Support network architecture and configuration for Kubernetes-based platforms, including ingress controls, load balancing, DNS, service connectivity, network policies and certificate management.
- Ensure development infrastructure complies with relevant standards, cybersecurity requirements, and regulations.
- Automate manual processes and drive continuous improvements in efficiency, reliability, traceability, and quality.
- Integrate security controls, vulnerability management, and compliance checks into the software development lifecycle.
- Evaluate, implement, and support AI-powered tools that enhance developer productivity.
- Administer developer tools and software, integrate development data sources to provide clear visibility and reporting across the product development lifecycle.

Our ideal candidate has a strong background in DevOps, automation, and software development tooling.

You are a proactive, hands-on professional who can apply industry best practices to modern, highly secure and regulated engineering environments.

Required Skills

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent.
- Minimum five years of relevant experience in DevOps, Build Engineering, Software Tooling, or a similar role.

- Strong communication skills in Finnish and English, both written and spoken.

Du är den operativa motparten till vår Business Object Leader (BOL). Tillsammans ser ni till att pm3-objektet är framåtlutat och inte bara reagerar på det som redan hänt. Du ser också till att IT prioriterar det som skapar mest värde för affären, när det behövs. Och du håller AI, cloud och nya arbetssätt på agendan hela tiden, inte som ett sidoprojekt.

Your role

We recognize the immense value that students bring to our company. Your academic rigor, combined with your enthusiasm for cutting-edge technology, allows you to approach problems with a unique and insightful lens. At Saab, you'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced engineers and specialists, gaining invaluable practical experience while making a tangible contribution to our growth and development.

Background

Modern mission systems rely on information from multiple distributed sensors and platforms to establish a shared picture of the operational environment. In contested and dynamic environments, however, the information received from other sources cannot always be assumed to be reliable. Sensors may be degraded or misconfigured, communication and processing chains may introduce dependencies, and information may even be deliberately manipulated. Moreover, information exchanged between platforms may have been fused previously, creating correlations that are difficult to identify and account for.

Future autonomous and mission-critical systems therefore need data-fusion methods that consider not only the statistical uncertainty of information, but also their trustworthiness. Such methods should be able to identify and reduce the influence of unreliable information while retaining valid observations, adapt when source behavior changes, and provide an understandable basis for how information contributes to the resulting situational picture.

Description of the Thesis Project
The purpose of this thesis project is to investigate trust-aware distributed data fusion, with particular focus on the fusion of state estimates, or tracks, exchanged between multiple platforms. The student will investigate how the trustworthiness of sources and information can be estimated dynamically and how these trust estimates can be incorporated into distributed fusion algorithms. Important challenges include unknown correlations between estimates, time-varying source reliability, and distinguishing faulty or deceptive information from trustworthy but unexpected observations.

The work is expected to include a literature study, development and implementation of suitable trust and fusion models, and evaluation through simulation in representative multi-platform scenarios. The developed methods may be evaluated in terms of estimation accuracy, resilience to unreliable or manipulated information, recovery, computational and communication requirements, and explainability.

The thesis will be carried out together within the Division of Mission Systems & Autonomy at Saab Aeronautics, which works with technologies and concepts for future combat aircraft systems. The project contributes to ongoing research and development on distributed sensing, data fusion, autonomy, and resilient mission systems, and gives the student an opportunity to work on a research problem closely connected to the development of future mission capabilities. The broader research theme is explicitly intended to connect focused master's thesis projects to longer-term challenges relevant to Saab.

The project is suitable for preferably one, at maximum two students with an interest in data fusion, target tracking, classification, machine learning, and cyber defense.

This is not a traditional IT support role. Acting as a bridge between IT and engineering teams, you will create and maintain the environments needed to develop and validate advanced defense technology. The role combines system administration, laboratory engineering, cybersecurity, and product platform support in a highly collaborative R&D environment.

In this hands-on role, you will be responsible for setting up, developing, and maintaining our laboratory systems, physical servers, engineering tools, networked test environments, and Windows-based product platforms. - Set up, develop, and maintain development, laboratory, and test infrastructure, including networks and physical engineering equipment.
- Administer Windows and Linux servers supporting engineering activities.
- Maintain engineering systems, development tools, user access models, and infrastructure configurations used in product development.
- Own and maintain the Windows-based platform used in one of our delivered products, including Windows OS upgrades, lifecycle management, security hardening, and configuration control.
- Troubleshoot issues affecting development infrastructure, laboratory systems, test environments, and product platform deployments.
- Create and maintain technical documentation and operational procedures.
- Support DevOps tools and processes during peak workloads and holiday seasons.

- Experience with Windows environments, including device provisioning, image management, or OS lifecycle management.
- Experience with server maintenance, system administration, and infrastructure support.
- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, operating systems, and device lifecycle management.
- Experience supporting software, testing, or engineering environments and equipment.
- Basic understanding of cybersecurity principles and system hardening practices.
- Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, Bash, or similar.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills in Finnish and English.

Desired Skills

- Familiarity with DevOps processes and tools such as GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, or similar.

Sweden

Din roll

Som specialist inom cybersäkerhet blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen av säkerhetslösningar för våra avancerade försvarsprodukter, såsom undervattenssensorer, autonoma undervattensfarkoster och torpedsystem. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan – från koncept och arkitektur till implementation, verifiering och driftsättning – och har ett särskilt ansvar för att driva och utveckla cybersäkerhetsområdet strategiskt.

I rollen ingår bland annat att:

- Leda och utveckla arbete med säker arkitektur, hotmodellering och säker systemdesign.
- Vara teknisk ledare och kompetensbärare inom cybersäkerhet – stötta projekt, systemingenjörer och utvecklingsteam i metoder, arbetssätt och tekniska lösningar.
- Påverka strategiska teknikval och bidra till långsiktig roadmap inom cybersäkerhet för undervattensdomänen.
- Delta i och ibland leda nationella och internationella FoU‑aktiviteter, samt representera Saab på konferenser och i samarbeten med kunder, partners och akademi.

Eftersom rollen spänner över flera projekt får du ett stort kontaktnät både internt och externt, och en vardag där du växlar mellan djup teknisk analys, rådgivning och långsiktigt strategiarbete.

Din profil

Vi söker dig som har gedigen erfarenhet av cybersäkerhet och vill ta en drivande specialistroll där du både fördjupar och breddar din kompetens.

Vi tror att du har:

- Civilingenjörsexamen eller motsvarande teknisk utbildning, gärna kompletterad med forskarutbildning eller motsvarande fördjupning, alternativt längre relevant industrivana.
- Flera års erfarenhet av cybersäkerhet i produktutveckling och/eller avancerade driftmiljöer.
- Djup kunskap inom något eller flera av följande områden: säker system- och mjukvaruarkitektur, kryptografi, identitets- och åtkomsthantering, säkerhetsanalys och hotmodellering, säker utvecklingsprocess, hårdvarunära säkerhet eller säkerhetsmonitorering.
- God förmåga att kommunicera komplexa tekniska frågeställningar på ett begripligt sätt, både på svenska och engelska.

Det är meriterande om du har:

- Erfarenhet av säkerhetsstandarder och ramverk (exempelvis KSF, NIST, ISO 2700x, Common Criteria eller motsvarande).
- Erfarenhet av säkerhetsarbete i reglerade miljöer, gärna inom försvar, kritisk infrastruktur eller motsvarande.
- Erfarenhet av att leda tekniska team, teknikområden eller communities of practice.
- Erfarenhet av samarbete med kunder, myndigheter eller internationella partners inom säkerhetsområdet.

Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och har ett starkt eget driv. Du tycker om att samarbeta, dela med dig av din kunskap och bidra till ett lärande klimat. Du trivs i komplexa systemmiljöer där teknik, processer och säkerhetskrav samspelar, och du ser det som naturligt att kontinuerligt hålla dig uppdaterad kring nya hot, tekniker och metoder.

Vänligen observera att vi arbetar med löpande urval och att tjänsten kan komma att tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum har passerat.

Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan det, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.

Med 28 000 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld. Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem.
